text.VENN_CAP: Phones are full of survivor-likes held upright, some of them 3D (Archero, Monster Survivors). Megabonk itself is on PC only. 88fits brings its kind of run, stages that end in a boss and a portal with shrines and quests on the way, to a phone held upright.

loop.s: Steer through the crowd; there is nothing else to press
Up to five weapons aim and fire on their own
Kills drop XP gems; chests, totems and barrels pay too
Paths mutate at set times; a full weapon evolves at a chest
The crowd grows bigger, stranger and faster

rows: One designer with AI tools; no publisher yet
Steam early access Dec 2021; phones Dec 2022
Portrait; 3D ground, a high fixed camera
Landscape; 3D, the camera behind the hero
One thumb: floating stick, guns fire themselves
Keys or pad: move, jump, slide; attacks automatic
Drag to run, release to shoot
7 to 13 minute stage, boss, portal, then Endless
10 minute stages, a boss and a portal
5 weapons, 5 cards, passives without a cap; mutations, evolutions
6 weapons and 6 passives; evolutions at chests
Upgrade board; quests unlock heroes and items
$4.99 on PC; free on phones with ads and IAP
1M copies in 2 weeks; 117,336 players at its peak

hud.s: Fills with every gem; when it is full, three cards are dealt.
Counts to the boss: 7:10 in Sundown. The level sits to its left.
The run's purse, and the only button on screen.
Each with its level on the corner, always in view.
A special glows in its own colour, an Elite wears a crown; the guns pick them first.
His health bar under him; being hurt jiggles the bar, never the screen.
Appears wherever the thumb lands; lift to stop.
